(pstar) at lines 258-260, with the general condition kappa>0, gamma>0 stated at line 74. The routing hint specifies two public controls kappa and gamma on the conservative finite benchmark interval [0.02, 0.42], which lies inside the source-supported positive domain. The private branch parameters n_order_one=1 and n_order_two=2 are supported by the source's statement that p_n_star applies for all n>0 (line 259) and the monotonic sequence p_{n+1}^* > p_n^* (line 262). The readout is the critical intervention probability p_n_star, an exact deterministic theorem. The extraction is faithful to the source; no classical p_c is used as a control. The case is authoring-ready with two claims sharing the same mechanism and readout, differing only in the private n parameter. The previously identified unused parameter pstar_denominator_offset has been removed. The common fixed condition iho_stochastic_channel is added and anchored to lines 130-158 and 247-260, and both claims cite it.",
